يستأمر (form X)
# يَسْتَأْمِرُ (yastaʔmiru) /jas.taʔ.mi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
# يُسْتَأْمَرُ (yustaʔmaru) /jus.taʔ.ma.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْمَرَ (istaʔmara)
# يَسْتَأْمِرَ (yastaʔmira) /jas.taʔ.mi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْمَر
